infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Butterfield uses the camera to scan loyalty QR codes and earn coffee stamps at the counter.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Butterfield uses Face ID to unlock your protected sign-in session when you choose biometric sign-in.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Butterfield uses Bluetooth to connect to supported in-store hardware such as receipt printers and cash drawer devices for Shop Display and POS operations.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Butterfield connects to receipt printers and cash drawer devices on your shop network for Shop Display and POS operations.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Butterfield uses your location to verify you are at a Butterfield store when signing in as a staff member.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Butterfield uses your photo library so you can upload a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Butterfield sends notifications for order updates, loyalty rewards, and special offers. You can manage these in Settings.

web.title: Butterfield Cookies — Sydney's Premium Café
web.description: Order freshly baked cookies, specialty coffee, and desserts from Butterfield — Sydney's premium café. Browse the full menu, earn loyalty points, and order online for pickup or delivery.
